newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo for crisis talks on Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo for crisis talks on Mideast peace.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak met Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in Cairo on Sunday for crisis talks on the Middle East peace process.
They met at the Ittihadiya presidential palace shortly after Arafat arrived from the Palestinian self-rule areas.
Palestinian-Israeli relations deteriorated after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the building of a Jewish settlement in disputed Arab East Jerusalem.
The housing scheme has sparked 10 days of clashes and a suicide bombing which killed three people in Tel Aviv.
Egypt, which regards itself as the unofficial sponsor of the Middle East peace talks, has said that Israel's policies have flung the region into instability and violence.
Arab and Islamic countries have also condemned the settlement and said that they would reconsider their ties with Israel unless it stopped construction work.

Arafat is also due to address a regular ministerial meeting of the Cairo-based Arab League which Egyptian newspapers said would issue a draft resolution calling on Arabs to suspend normalisation of ties with the Jewish state until it ceased settlement work.
